Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3611 (equivalent to G3612); a residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.
BiblicalUsage: Oiketerion is a habitation, a dwelling, a house. In 2 Corinthians 5:2 believers groan, desiring to be clothed upon with their house from heaven, and in Jude 1:6 the angels who left their own habitation are kept in everlasting chains under darkness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every creature has a habitation God gave it, and the angels who left theirs show what happens when a dwelling is despised.
